description: Source code for SATA driver and initialization routines for Oxford Semiconductor's oxnas platform, including DMA setup, SATA PHY reset, and disk detection.

methods.name: ide_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from SATA register port for a given device.

methods.name: wait_no_error
methods.description: Waits until SATA core flags no error condition or times out.

methods.name: wait_sata_command_not_busy
methods.description: Waits until SATA command register indicates not busy.

methods.name: ide_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to SATA register port for a given device, handling command setup.

methods.name: encode_start
methods.description: Encodes control register value to start DMA transfer.

methods.name: dma_start
methods.description: Starts DMA transfer by writing to DMA control register.

methods.name: encode_control_status
methods.description: Encodes DMA control register value based on source and destination settings.

methods.name: encode_final_eot
methods.description: Encodes final transfer size and EOT flags for DMA.

methods.name: dma_start_write
methods.description: Configures and initiates DMA write transfer.

methods.name: dma_start_read
methods.description: Configures and initiates DMA read transfer.

methods.name: wait_dma_not_busy
methods.description: Polls until DMA channel is not busy or times out, with cleanup.

methods.name: wait_not_busy
methods.description: Polls ATA status register until device is not busy or times out.

methods.name: ide_output_data
methods.description: Outputs data to SATA device via DMA, waits for completion.

methods.name: ide_input_data
methods.description: Reads data from SATA device via DMA, applies workaround for bug.

methods.name: scr_read
methods.description: Reads a SATA link register via async mechanism.

methods.name: scr_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a SATA link register via async mechanism.

methods.name: phy_reset
methods.description: Resets and initializes SATA PHY, waits for PHY to be ready.

methods.name: wait_FIS
methods.description: Waits for FIS (Frame Information Structure) from SATA device.

methods.name: workaround5458
methods.description: Applies hardware workaround by configuring ASIC registers.

methods.name: ide_preinit
methods.description: Initializes SATA interfaces, detects disks, applies workarounds, and clears errors.
